purpose: Canonical governance registry for strategies allowed to appear as active platform strategies. This file governs status and permissions; strategy parameters remain in src/lib/strategyProfiles.ts and data/strategy-config.json.

statusDefinitions.research: Exploratory only; cannot appear as an active strategy or trade ticket.
statusDefinitions.sealed-pass: Passed a sealed evaluation, but no platform trading permission is implied.
statusDefinitions.paper-approved: Allowed for paper trading and platform workflow validation only.
statusDefinitions.suspended: Evidence invalidated or under model-risk review; no new entries (paper or live). Existing positions may still be managed and closed, and are retained for display and audit.
statusDefinitions.live-adopted: Allowed for live trading after model-risk, data, execution, and risk signoff.
statusDefinitions.retired: Historical only; retained for audit and legacy position display.
